head: codex/87-acip-minor-version-strict-clippy
title: [v0.92][runtime][ci] Fix ACIP minor-version strict Clippy failure
body:
Closes #87

Preserves general inclusive ACIP minor-version negotiation with a RangeInclusive predicate after malformed-range rejection, eliminating the strict Clippy constant-extreme warning without weakening future minor-version compatibility. Adds focused exact, wider, future-only, and descending-range coverage.

Validation: focused ACIP test 2/2, strict library Clippy, formatting check, and both issue-named capability-advertisement and resource-weather consumer Clippy commands. All proof logs and exact child/product compositions are retained under `.csdlc/evidence/87/`. Exact-head independent review completed with no findings.
